data.one_liner: Widget that runs GLSL shaders and feeds their output to other shaders or widgets
data.what_it_does: ShaderBuffers lets you load fragment shaders from assets, pass uniforms, capture pointer events, and chain multiple shader layers. It exposes a controller to play, pause, rewind and query shader state.
use_when: You need to display ShaderToy-like effects in a Flutter app
You want to layer multiple shaders and use their outputs as textures
You need interactive shaders that respond to touch or mouse
avoid_when: You only need simple image or color manipulation
You are targeting iOS with Impeller enabled (may have issues)
strengths: Easy to set up with a single widget
Supports multiple layers and custom uniforms
weaknesses: Requires Flutter 3.10+ and may not work on Impeller
data.setup_notes: Add package to pubspec, import, provide shader assets and LayerBuffer definitions
